vibe: Tactical Minimalism, authoritative broadcast scoreboard, high-energy athletic, precision control room

rules.headings: Use Bebas Neue for all score numbers, timers, and athlete names on the public broadcast display. Tracking must be tight (`tracking-tighter`).
rules.body: Use Inter for operator dashboards, rules configuration, and standard tabular data.

layout_strategy.spacing_scale: Generous spacing for dashboards (p-6 to p-8 inner padding).

grid_modes.dashboard_operator: MODE B: 'CONTROL ROOM'. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 or gap-6. Dense, data-heavy, full height columns. Flat solid surfaces.
grid_modes.tablet_jury: Split-screen layout (Red vs Blue). Massive tap targets for point inputs (+1, +2, +3). Use 50vh minimum for the tap areas. No complex navigation on screen.
grid_modes.public_display: Minimal persistent compact bar or focused center layout. Black or dark textured background. Highest contrast possible. Large sans-serif text, state-driven color cues (Red/Blue).

layout_strategy.surfaces: Use 'Tactical Minimalism'. Flat solid backgrounds for health/scores. 1px solid borders (`border-white/10`). Avoid soft shadows; use 1px inner highlights if necessary.

components.buttons: Shadcn based. Use primary colors (Red/Blue/Accent) only for crucial actions. All jury buttons MUST have a minimum height of `h-20` or `h-24` for rapid tapping.
components.cards: Cardless or sharp rectangular edges. Maximum 4px border-radius (`rounded-sm`).
components.inputs: Shadcn forms with heavy customization. Focus states must have `ring-2 ring-white/50`.
components.public_scoreboard: Custom HTML/Tailwind. Absolute positioning or CSS Grid for precise broadcast layout.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Hover states must explicitly set `text-white` and use a lighter background hue.
motion_and_interactions.active_states: Buttons must physically press down (`active:translate-y-1`) for tactile feedback.
motion_and_interactions.public_display_animations: Subtle entry animations. Score changes should pulse briefly.

public_display_background.description: Dark textured plaster wall. Use as a low-opacity background for the Public Display to break up the flat black.

indonesia_cultural_texture.description: Traditional batik pattern. Use as a very subtle overlay (opacity 5-10%) masked behind athlete sections or headers to give an Indonesian signature.

silhouette_decoration.description: Martial arts silhouette. Can be used in empty states or loading screens.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA contrast. Especially white text on the Red/Blue corner backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, score inputs, tabs) MUST include `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid="red-score-button-1"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a Pencak Silat real-time scoring application using React, Tailwind, and Shadcn UI. The interface is Bahasa Indonesia.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all interactive elements, matching kebab-case, role-based naming.
This is an athletic, high-stakes application. Do not use generic SaaS look. Use tactical, dark mode styling (Archetype 2: Performance Pro).
Jury Tablet view must have massive, highly clickable tap areas for scoring. No small icons.
Public display must emulate Olympic-grade broadcast scoreboards: massive typography (Bebas Neue), persistent compact layout, high contrast, state-driven color cues.
Strictly adhere to the Red (Sudut Merah) vs Blue (Sudut Biru) visual separation. These are non-negotiable identities for the athletes.
All score rules/points must be data-driven, do not hardcode the points logic deeply into the UI.
Implement WebSockets (mocked if backend unavailable) for real-time score streaming.
Do not use generic transparent headers over content without a solid background or heavy backdrop-blur.
